title: Insufficient Nodes in Root to Leaf Paths
summary: Given a binary tree and an integer limit, remove nodes that are insufficient, where an insufficient node is defined as one where every root-to-leaf path passing through it has a sum strictly less than the limit.
statement: Given a binary tree and an integer limit, remove nodes that are insufficient, where an insufficient node is defined as one where every root-to-leaf path passing through it has a sum strictly less than the limit. A leaf node is a node with no children. Return the root of the modified binary tree.
constraints: Delete every node not lying on any root-to-leaf path with sum at least limit.
Return the remaining root or None.
